cards.name: Akroan Hoplite
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks, it gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of attacking creatures you control.

cards.name: Battlewise Hoplite
cards.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature, then scry 1. (To scry 1, look at the top card of your library, then you may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.name: Bloodcrazed Hoplite
cards.oracleText:
Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Whenever a +1/+1 counter is put on this creature, remove a +1/+1 counter from target creature an opponent controls.

cards.name: Favored Hoplite
cards.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn.

cards.name: Satyr Hoplite
cards.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

cards.name: Reverent Hoplite
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens equal to your devotion to white. (Each {W} in the mana costs of permanents you control counts toward your devotion to white.)

cards.name: Mirror-Shield Hoplite
cards.oracleText:
Vigilance
Whenever a creature you control becomes the target of a backup ability, copy that ability. You may choose new targets for the copy. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Sunlit Hoplite
cards.oracleText:
During your turn, this creature has first strike.
This creature gets +1/+0 as long as you control an Elspeth planeswalker.
